observations: Measured bounded operational target workload across quarantine stream & seal, custody append & checkpoint, timeline indexing & search, export packaging & verify, and restore & rebuild steps on local host (16 vCPU AMD Ryzen 7, 30829 MiB RAM, 90924 MiB free disk).

Observed total pipeline p50 latency ~21.1ms, p95 ~22.6ms, max ~22.6ms against bounded thresholds (target p50 <= 250ms, p95 <= 1000ms, max <= 5000ms), with peak RSS well below the 1024 MiB bound and zero disk growth leakage.

Exercised 9 overload saturation and fault conditions (oversized_evidence_stream -> upload_too_large, search_max_results_exceeded -> query_limit_exceeded, search_max_scan_events_exceeded -> query_limit_exceeded, search_expand_depth_exceeded -> query_limit_exceeded, search_max_expand_degree_exceeded -> query_limit_exceeded, search_max_visited_nodes_exceeded -> query_limit_exceeded, client_context_cancellation -> context_canceled, concurrency_lock_contention -> lock_busy, and simulated_disk_full_fault -> disk_full), confirming fail-closed error semantics before side effects or state corruption.
Verified core immutability invariant that sealed source bytes (SHA-256 digest) are never modified during any target, overload, or recovery workload steps.
Emitted published limits and benchmark measurements to docs/evidence/performance.json.
